title: CRLR/96/2017 of Pradeep Sharma AND OTHERS Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Criminal Revision No. 96 of 2017
Pradeep Sharma and others Ö..Revisionists
Vs.
State of Uttarakhand and another Ö..Respondents
Mr. H.C. Pathak, Advocate for the revisionist.
Mr. K.S. Rautela, G.A. with Mr. Milind Raj, Brief Holder for the State.
Honíble V.K. Bist, J.

Heard.
2. It is contended by the learned counsel for the
revisionists that one transfer application was moved by the
revisionists before Honíble Supreme Court for transfer of the
case from District Dehradun to Ghaziabad. The transfer
application was dismissed on 18.11.2016, but, the Honíble
Supreme Court permitted the revisionists that if they apply for
exemption for personal appearance, the court below will
consider the same in accordance with law.
3. Learned counsel for the revisionists submitted that
the revisionists moved an application for exemption from
personal appearance, but, in spite of Honíble Supreme Courtís
order, the trial court directed the revisionists to appear
personally and cross-examined the complainant. It is further
submitted that revisionist no. 1 is undergoing for dialysis thrice
in a week, revisionist no. 2 has lost his 60% eye sight and
revisionist no. 3 is unable to come, as she has to take care of her
husband, namely, Pradeep Kumar (revisionist no. 1). It is also
submitted that revisionists are not against the order by which
19th April 2017 is fixed for cross-examination; they are simply
seeking their personal exemption for appearance.

2
4. I have considered the submission of the learned
counsel for the revisionists, the grounds which have been taken
by the learned counsel for the revisionists are not sufficient to
admit the revision. In such circumstances, the revision is liable
to be dismissed.
5. The revision is dismissed. But considering the
submission of the learned counsel for the revisionists and
considering the order passed by the Honíble Supreme Court
dated 18.11.2016 in Transfer Petition (Criminal) Nos. 298-
301/2015, it is directed that in case revisionists move
application/applications for exemption, same shall be
considered by the court concerned in accordance with law.
6. Let a copy of the judgment be issued today itself.
